messages:

To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@greenbridge.org
Date: Sun, 26 Jul 2026 13:08:00 -0000
Subject: Inquiry: nonprofit accelerator sponsorship & credits

Hi Grace,

Thanks for taking time to speak with Ana from our team last week. GreenBridge Labs is running a 6-month accelerator for environmental nonprofits starting in September and were exploring partners for compute credits + a low-cost Dedicated tier option for a cohort pilot. A few specifics wed love clarity on: 

- Can Redwood combine promotional onboarding credits with a nonprofit sponsorship discount for pilot cohorts?
- If the cohort wants reserved GPU capacity for demo days (short bursts), is there an option to attach a short-term Dedicated pool at a discounted monthly rate?
- We have procurement requirements (PO + vendor form) and a preference to have credits appear as a line item rather than a one-off grant — is that something your billing team can accommodate?

Ive attached the high level SOW request and budget range. Happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Best,
Maria Santos
Program Director, GreenBridge Labs
From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Maria Santos <maria@greenbridge.org>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 27 Jul 2026 08:14:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Inquiry: nonprofit accelerator sponsorship & credits

Hi Maria — great to hear from you and thanks for the SOW. I looped in Ben (sales lead) and Marissa (partnerships) so we can coordinate commercial + go-to-market support. Quick answers up front, then next steps below.

Short answers:
- Yes — we can combine a promotional onboarding credit package with an additional sponsorship discount for nonprofit cohorts. We typically structure this as two line items: onboarding credit (one-time) + discounted monthly reserved capacity for the pilot period.
- Short-burst Dedicated pools are supported. For demo days we recommend a temporary Dedicated cluster with a small commit (e.g., 4–8 GPU-hours/day windows) and autoscale disabled during the burst; we can offer a pilot discount off our standard Dedicated rate.
- Billing: we can show the credits as a line item and issue invoices that align with your PO requirements. Procurement forms are fine — Marissa will own the paperwork and Ben will own pricing.

Proposed next steps:
1) Ben: can you draft a proposed pricing sketch (onboarding credits + 3-month discounted Dedicated rate) that fits their budget range?
2) Marissa: can you confirm what vendor documentation (W9, SOC2 summary) we can attach and estimate SLA carveouts?
3) Maria: if you can share a target budget number for the pilot (range is fine) well lock a two-week hold on the pricing sketch while procurement completes the PO.

Attachments: I see the SOW you sent (greenbridge-sow-request.pdf). Ill attach a quick approval letter once Ben and I align.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if thats easier.

—Grace

Grace / Maria — I pulled a quick sketch based on the SOW and typical cohort sizes for similar programs. Summary below; full spreadsheet (internal) available on request.

Pricing sketch (pilot = 3 months):
- One-time onboarding credits: $25,000 (applied as a line item credit).
- Discounted Dedicated commit: 4 x A100-equivalent GPUs reserved for 3 months, standard rate $18k/mo -> pilot price $9k/mo (50% nonprofit sponsor discount) = $27,000 total for 3 months.
- Burst demo days: included up to 10 GPU-hours/day during 2 demo weeks; additional burst billed at our spot rate.
- PR/comms add-on: co-branded case study support (no charge) if youre open to one.

Notes/assumptions:
- The onboarding credit shows on invoice as a negative line item and can be referenced in the PO.
- Discount applies only to the Dedicated commit; hosted API usage outside the reserve would be billed at standard rates unless you want to pre-buy additional credits.
- We can provide a short-term contract addendum that limits the discount to the 3-month pilot and includes basic SLA assurances.

Next steps I propose:
- If this looks directionally correct, Ill produce a one-page commercial term sheet and Marissa will help prep the vendor packet (W9, SOC2 summary, standard MSA excerpts).
